BiblicalUsage: Dimonah was a town in the south of Judah, listed among the cities given to the tribe in the allotment. Its name, like Dimon, means river bed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every town in the allotment counted, even the small southern ones, because God's gift to Judah came with borders He drew Himself.
